mapper.select: /* * SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.etxpyreqstdmng.mapper.OvtiWorkEtxpyAplyMngMapper.selectOvtiWorkEtxpyAplyMngDetail3 : 월별시간외수당 list * 작성자 : Jeong.Won.Je */ WITH ZZ AS ( SELECT #{YYYYMM} AS YYYYMM , #{USER_ID} AS USER_ID FROM DUAL ) SELECT SUBSTR(T1.RLVT_YM, 1, 4)||'년 '||SUBSTR(T1.RLVT_YM, 5, 2) || '월' AS GIVE_YM , SUBSTR(T1.APRV_YMD, 1, 4)||'년 '||SUBSTR(T1.APRV_YMD, 5, 2) || '월' AS APRV_YM , T1.OVTIME_WORK_SHAPE_SE_CD AS OVTIME_WORK_SHAPE_SE_CD , T1.EXCESS_WORK_HR AS EXCESS_WORK_HR , T1.PENSN_RCGNTN_HR AS PENSN_RCGNTN_HR , T1.PENSN_SUM_AMT AS PENSN_SUM_AMT , T1.APRV_YN AS APRV_YN FROM ZZ , AYC370 T1 /* 시간외근무수당 */ WHERE 1=1 AND T1.RLVT_YM = ZZ.YYYYMM AND T1.CONSTT_ID = ZZ.USER_ID ORDER BY OVTIME_WORK_SHAPE_SE_CD ASC
